title: capitalETH
tagline: capitalETH - A smart, systematic and hassle-free way to invest in tokens on Ethereum.
description:
capitalETH aims to solve a major problem in Decentralized Finance - Investing. capitalETH helps you invest systematically and in a disciplined way so you can sit tight and invest right!

Instead of investing in bulk at once, you can create a goal and invest small amounts systematically just like a SIP (Systematic Investment Plan) in traditional finance. The main advantage is that you average out the buy price, reducing the risk of buying at the high price and also get the benefit of compounding.
how_its_made: The project uses Kyber to swap the source tokens to destination tokens, Aave to earn interest on source tokens, and Portis is used for easy user interface.
